claims.statement: Shadbala consists of six components: Sthana Bala (positional), Dig Bala (directional), Kala Bala (temporal), Naisargika Bala (natural), Cheshta Bala (motional), and Drik Bala (aspect). This is confirmed across BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata, and Saravali.
claims.formula_description: Total Shadbala = (Sthana + Dig + Kala + Naisargika + Cheshta + Drik) * vimshopaka_factor

claims.statement: Sthana Bala has seven sub-components: Uccha Bala (exaltation), Saptavargaja Bala (7-varga dignity), Ojayyugmarasyamsha Bala (odd/even rashi/pada), Kendra Bala (quadrant), Drekkana Bala (decant), and overall sign-position strength.

Dig Bala is determined by planet's position in house relative to ascendant. Maximum Dig Bala (60 rupas) occurs at specific houses: Jupiter/Mercury in 1st/7th, Sun/Mars in 10th, Moon in 4th, Venus/Saturn in 7th/1st.
Kala Bala includes Nathonatha Bala (day/night), Ayana Bala (solstice), Varsha Bala (annual), Masa Bala (monthly), Vara Bala (day of week), Hora Bala (hour lord), and Ayush Bala (age of planet).

Naisargika Bala assigns fixed natural-strength values to planets: Sun=60, Moon=51.4286 (360/7), Jupiter=42.8571 (300/7), Venus=34.2857 (240/7), Mercury=25.7143 (180/7), Mars=17.1429 (120/7), Saturn=8.5714 (60/7). Units are rupas. Values are derived from a proportional allocation of 420 rupas total.

Cheshta Bala requires validated apparent motion (daily motion in arc-seconds) and retrograde/direct/stationary state. The formula uses: Cheshta Bala = (apparent_motion / maximum_motion) * 60. Retrograde planets receive Cheshta Bala from their motion; stationary planets receive maximum.
claims.implementation_dependency: P012 canonical motion facts (speed, retrograde, stationary)

claims.statement: Drik Bala is derived from aspectual contributions of other planets. Each planet aspects specific houses from its position with varying strengths: full aspects (7th), special aspects (5th/9th for Mars, 5th/9th for Jupiter, 3rd/10th for Saturn). Each aspect contributes a fixed value based on the aspecting planet's Drik Bala table.

Bhinna Ashtakavarga (BAV) assigns bindus (points) based on a planet's position in a sign relative to all other planets. The contribution table specifies which relative positions (1st through 12th) receive bindus for each planet. Sun contributes in signs 1,2,4,7,8,9,10,11. Moon in 1,3,6,7,8,10,11. Mars in 1,2,4,7,8,9,10,11. Mercury in 1,2,4,6,8,9,10,11. Jupiter in 1,2,3,4,5,7,9,10,11. Venus in 1,2,3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12. Saturn in 1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11.

Sarvashtakavarga (SAV) is the sum of all BAV columns for each sign position. SAV[sign] = sum of BAV[Sun][sign] + BAV[Moon][sign] + ... + BAV[Saturn][sign]. Maximum theoretical SAV per sign is 56 (8 planets * 7 possible bindus). SAV provides overall house strength.

Vimshopaka weights convert raw Bala to normalized scores. D1=1, D2=1, D3=1, D4=1, D7=1, D9=1, D10=1, D12=1, D16=1, D20=1, D24=1, D27=1, D30=1, D40=1, D45=1, D60=1. Total=16. Some traditions use different weights; the BPHS standard is equal weights of 1 each for 16 divisions.
